::: {style="display: none;"}
```{webr-r}
#| autorun: true
# ==============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION & CONSTANTS
# ==============================================================================
APP_CONFIG <- list(
  data_dir       = "data/rds/",
  limit_mld      = 10,
  threshold_kg   = 1.0,
  theme_primary  = "#2c3e50",
  days_per_year  = 365,
  ml_to_l        = 1e6,
  m3_to_l        = 1e3, #new To add to Chris
  kg_to_g        = 1e3,
  m3_to_kg       = 1e3,
  ng_to_kg       = 1e-12,
  zero_tol       = 1e-9   # Tolerance for filtering empty mass rows
)
#Treatment of Not measured and non detects
#Not measured = NA
#Below reporting detection limit = taken 1/2 of the value
below_detection_limit_factor <- 0.5
options(scipen = 9999)
```
:::

Change the below values according to your plant's annual amount.
```{webr-r}
effluent_L<-999
biosolid_kg<-123
```

```{webr-r}
effluent_L * 1000
biosolid_kg * 5
```


## Quarto

You may have noticed when you arrived that ‘WEBR STATUS: 🟡 Loading…’ was shown at the top of the post before changing to ‘🟢 Ready!’ to indicate that the WebR chunks are ready to use.

```{webr-r}
below_detection_limit_factor
```

```{webr-r}
url <- "https://jjyh.github.io/npri-default-pfas/Table_1.rds"
download.file(url, "Table_1.rds")
# Read the flights data into R
dummy <- readRDS("Table_1.rds")

# See the first few rows of the flights_from_csv data frame.
cat("Let's view the first 6 observations of data:\n")
head(dummy)
```

```{webr}
# 2. Read your preloaded dataset
my_data <- readRDS("Table_1.rds")
table_subset <- head(my_data, n = 5)

# 3. Create your gt table object
formatted_table <- table_subset %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "PFAS Interaction Data",
    subtitle = "Rendered live via webR"
  )

# 4. FIX: Disable inlining of CSS styles to fix the webR crash
html_string <- as_raw_html(formatted_table, inline_css = FALSE)

# 5. Render visually inside the user's browser
htmltools::HTML(html_string)
```
